subject: Mutual Action Plan Kickoff — CloudBridge AWS listing & 6-week evaluation
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Elena Rodriguez <elena@aws-partners.com>, Priya Menon <priya@cloudbridge.com>
Cc: Soojín Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 14 Mar 2025 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Mutual Action Plan Kickoff — CloudBridge AWS listing & 6-week evaluation

Hi all,

Thanks for lining up time on this — I wanted to kick off a short MAP for the CloudBridge AWS marketplace listing and the associated 6-week evaluation plan. Goal: get the listing live in the AWS marketplace, complete a technical eval with CloudBridge's integration team, and agree on a go/no-go decision and commercial close window by the end of the 6th week.

High-level timeline (proposal):
- Week 0 (this week): MAP kickoff, roles & access, metadata handoff to AWS listing team
- Week 1–2: Technical onboarding (test images, integration smoke tests, KV access for billing reporting)
- Week 3: Listing copy + connector verification + pricing SKU mapping
- Week 4–5: Joint evaluation with a 3-customer pilot and performance checks (latency & cost targets)
- Week 6: Final quality review, commercial terms, DocuSign, and go/no-go decision

Owners (initial):
- Redwood listing metadata & AWS fields: Ben Carter
- Integration test plan & pilot coordination: Jonas Weber + CloudBridge engineering (Priya)
- AWS marketplace ops liaison: Elena Rodriguez
- Evaluation criteria / success metrics: Soojín Lee (quality monitoring)

Attachments: MAP_CloudBridge_AWS_v1.xlsx (MAP template with milestones), listing_metadata_template.csv (fields we need filled by CloudBridge).

Action items for this note: please reply with any missing stakeholders, and confirm ownership if the names above look right. Priya/CloudBridge — can you confirm your engineering lead and a contact who can supply the packaging artifacts?

Proposed kickoff meeting: Tue Mar 18, 10:00–10:30 PDT — if that works I will send a calendar invite and the MAP draft.

Thanks,
Marissa

Marissa Cole
Sr. Director, Partnerships & GTM
Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0183
